Title: [SPIKE-001] Evaluate Places providers
Description: Requirement: SPIKE-001. Compare at least 3 providers on coverage in launch areas (incl. street food), price/opening-hours/cuisine fields, caching and display licence terms, cost per request. Output: recommendation + budget-filter approach (see GATE1 F-01, F-03). Blocks PLAT-003. Source: docs/GATE1_DECISION_PACKAGE.md §5

Title: [SPIKE-002] PDPA review: notice, lawful basis, retention, minors, cross-border
Description: Requirement: SPIKE-002. Draft Thai privacy notice (PDPA s.23), confirm lawful basis (s.19/24), retention figures (Q-002), minimum age (Q-003), cross-border transfer basis (Q-004). Needs external legal review. Blocks PRIV-001. Source: docs/PRD.md §7

Title: [PLAT-001] App shell: Expo + TypeScript, tabs, i18n, tokens, CI, Sentry
Description: Requirement: PLAT-001. AC in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md. Starts only after Gate 2 approval.

Title: [AUTH-001] Sign in with Apple / Google, account linking, sign out, delete account
Description: Requirement: AUTH-001 (D-011, D-012). Login required at first decision confirmation (browse and see shortlist without account), max 2 taps, no forms; pending decision is confirmed automatically after sign-in; local pre-login data migrates into the account. Link both providers to one account; at least one must remain. In-app account deletion. Includes Apple Developer and Google Cloud credential setup. Risk R-006: App Store guideline 5.1.1(v). Depends on PLAT-001, PLAT-002.

Title: [PLAT-002] Supabase schema, Auth providers (Apple, Google), RLS and RLS tests
Description: Requirement: PLAT-002. Tables: profiles, preferences, decision_sessions, decisions, feedback, consent_log. CI fails on any table without RLS policy. Depends on PLAT-001.

Title: [ANL-001] Event instrumentation, schema tests, dashboard
Description: Requirement: ANL-001. Events and KPI formulas in docs/ANALYTICS_PLAN.md. No coordinates or free text in events. Depends on PLAT-001.

Title: [PLAT-003] Places adapter Edge Function with rate limit, daily cost cap, kill switch
Description: Requirement: PLAT-003. Provider behind searchPlaces(criteria) interface. Cache only as licence allows. Depends on SPIKE-001, PLAT-002.

Title: [PRIV-001] Location pre-prompt, privacy notice, consent log, delete my data
Description: Requirement: PRIV-001. AC in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on SPIKE-002, PLAT-002.

Title: [SOLO-001] Home: budget, cuisine, radius, location or area
Description: Requirement: SOLO-001. Budget is a cap (D-002). Denied-location path with area picker. Emits criteria_completed (D-001). No login required on this screen (D-011). Depends on PLAT-001, PRIV-001.

Title: [SOLO-002] Shortlist of up to 3 places with reasons and all states
Description: Requirement: SOLO-002. States: 3 results, 1-2 results, none, slow, error. No repeats on reroll. Depends on SOLO-001, PLAT-003.

Title: [SOLO-003] Idempotent decision confirmation and Time to Yes
Description: Requirement: SOLO-003. TTY = decision_confirmed - first criteria_completed in session (D-001, A-001). Unique (user_id, session_id). Offline retry with same decision_id. Requires signed-in user (AUTH-001); event carries included_auth. Depends on SOLO-002, PLAT-002, ANL-001, AUTH-001.

Title: [SOLO-004] Open external map navigation
Description: Requirement: SOLO-004. Native maps deep link with browser fallback; copyable address on failure. Depends on SOLO-003.

Title: [SOLO-005] Feedback, stored preferences and Me tab
Description: Requirement: SOLO-005. Thumbs up boosts ranking, thumbs down hides place. Depends on SOLO-003.

Title: [GRP-001] Kampai clickable prototype (synthetic data)
Description: Requirement: GRP-001. Delivered as prototype/index.html. Tie: organizer chooses (D-003). Non-response = abstain (D-004). Awaiting founder acceptance.

Title: [REL-001] Beta release preparation
Description: Requirement: REL-001. TestFlight, Play internal testing, store privacy disclosures. Gate 4. Depends on all Must items.

Title: [OPS-001] Founder runbook: kill switch, cost alerts, data breach notification
Description: Requirement: OPS-001. One page. Includes PDPA s.37(4) 72-hour notification steps. Depends on PLAT-003, PRIV-001.
